name: Activity Discovery
description: A fresh activity idea with practical details and a link when available.
template:
<Stack gap="xs">
<Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap" gap="xs"><Text fw={600} truncate>Activity discovery</Text><RefreshButton requestId="q" label="Another idea" /></Group>
{status.q?.loading ? <Skeleton height={92} /> : status.q?.ok === false ? <Alert color="red" title="Suggestion unavailable">{status.q.statusText || status.q.error || "Request failed"}</Alert> : !data.q?.activity ? <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">No activity suggestion is available.</Text> : <Stack gap="xs"><Text fz={24} fw={700} lh={1.15} c="blue">{data.q.activity}</Text>{data.q.link ? <Anchor href={data.q.link} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Open activity</Anchor> : <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">No link available</Text>}<SimpleGrid minColWidth={140} autoFlow="auto-fit" spacing="xs"><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap" gap="xs"><Text size="sm" c="dimmed">Type</Text><Text size="sm" truncate>{data.q.type ?? "Unknown"}</Text></Group><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap" gap="xs"><Text size="sm" c="dimmed">Availability</Text><Text size="sm">{data.q.availability == null ? "—" : Math.round(data.q.availability * 100).toLocaleString("en-US") + "%"}</Text></Group><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap" gap="xs"><Text size="sm" c="dimmed">Participants</Text><Text size="sm">{data.q.participants?.toLocaleString("en-US") ?? "—"}</Text></Group><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap" gap="xs"><Text size="sm" c="dimmed">Price score</Text><Text size="sm">{data.q.price == null ? "—" : Math.round(data.q.price * 100).toLocaleString("en-US") + "%"}</Text></Group><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap" gap="xs"><Text size="sm" c="dimmed">Accessibility</Text><Text size="sm" truncate>{data.q.accessibility ?? "Unknown"}</Text></Group><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap" gap="xs"><Text size="sm" c="dimmed">Duration</Text><Text size="sm">{data.q.duration ?? "Unknown"}</Text></Group><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap" gap="xs"><Text size="sm" c="dimmed">Kid friendly</Text><Text size="sm">{data.q.kidFriendly === true ? "Yes" : data.q.kidFriendly === false ? "No" : "Unknown"}</Text></Group></SimpleGrid><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap" gap="xs"><Text size="sm" c="dimmed">Activity ID</Text><Text size="sm">{data.q.key ?? "—"}</Text></Group></Stack>}</Stack>
